opening.argument: The institutional interview focuses on how a digital-asset treasury approaches yield, not on directing viewers to transact. The discussion explains that lending a token for longer can raise rates as the lender accepts more illiquidity, while expressly acknowledging risk when assets are deployed to seek yield. It also raises the possibility of a protocol hack and the need for a smart-contract audit. Those qualifications are part of the analysis, not incidental to it. The description further states that nothing discussed is intended as investment advice. Together, the interview format, risk discussion, and disclaimer support an informational reading without claiming that any investment outcome is assured.
